design: Tier 2: a migration. HAZARD: migration 0139 reaches the operator's real database the next time their :8000 Hub restarts on a checkout that holds it. It only creates a table (guarded for one already present); no existing row is read or rewritten and nothing is backfilled. ROLLBACK: alembic downgrade to 0138 drops vault_readers and loses only the attribution; vault_fetches is untouched. D1. A table beside vault_fetches, keyed (project_id, entry_id, agent), with count and last_read_at, bumped in the same own-transaction record_fetch the read already uses, so a failure to record never fails the read. D2. The agent is AgentActor.agent, from the run credential; nothing in the request names it. D3. Every route that lists fetches lists readers ({agent, count, last_read_at}, most recent first, [] when none); a count from before 0139 stays unattributed, so fetches may exceed the readers' sum and the UI says so. D4. Project deletion sweeps the table like every project-scoped table.

problem: The Vault reader's Used by tab could say how often agents read an entry but never which agents: vault_fetches (migration 0126) holds one count per entry and no agent (F836).

requirements.rationale: Which agents rely on an entry is what tells the operator whether a wrong entry has already misled work (F836).
requirements.statement: An agent's read of a vault entry at offset 0 MUST be recorded against the agent its run credential names, and no request field or header MAY name it. GET /vault/map, GET /vault/entries/{id} and the agents' map and entry routes MUST list readers on each entry: one {agent, count, last_read_at} per agent that read it, most recent first, and an empty list when none is known. The operator's own reads MUST NOT be recorded as a reader.

requirements.rationale: The map's ordering is built on fetches; attribution must not change it.
requirements.statement: Recording readers MUST NOT change how fetches and last_fetched_at are counted or how the map is ordered, and the migration that adds the readers' table MUST leave every existing row as it was, its downgrade removing only that table.
